description: Hides crossed-out prices, discount percentages, and redundant price rows in the cart total.
name: Show final prices only

description: Skips the VK ID authorization suggestion shown during app installs and updates.
name: Skip update authentication

name: Expose like status in MediaSession

description: Removes ads by forcing TeamSnap+ Tier 1 subscription status.
name: Disable ads

description: Forces pure-black app background in dark mode (window_background_color -> #000000). Surfaces/cards keep stock greys; light mode untouched.
name: AMOLED black background

description: Forces AdSettings.noAd=true and PlayQueue.getDisableAds=true so songs are treated as ad-free locally. Client flag only.
name: Disable audio ads

description: Playlist/album headers show Play + Shuffle instead of Shuffle + Edit/Follow/Like (functional LEAVECOLLAB, local-songs ADD_MORE and podcasts untouched). Pulls in 'Unforce shuffle'.
name: Header Play + Shuffle

description: Forces Account.isGold/isGoldUser and all GoldUtilsKt.isGold overloads to false. Hides server-gated Gold UI instead of spoofing it.
name: Hide Gold features

description: Hides PLAYS IN SHUFFLE badges on playlist/album headers, feed cards, and rows. Cosmetic only.
name: Hide shuffle badges

description: Hides the nav upgrade entry, header promo banner, feed upsell cards and AI MIX button model (gap-free), and settings subscribe banner. Server-driven UI the Plus spoof cannot remove.
name: Hide upgrade upsell

description: Hides TRY SING ALONG karaoke upsell, disables the karaoke feature itself, and hides the player/playlist AI MIX buttons. Feature UI stays hidden rather than paywalled.
name: Hide upsell feature buttons

description: When the server returns truncated/empty lyrics, fetches the full text from LRCLIB (opt-in free source) into a separate cache. Native full lyrics and the Plus path are untouched.
name: LRCLIB lyrics fallback

description: Long-press play/pause for lyrics options (retry, LRCLIB search, synced/plain toggle, server version) instead of the sleep timer. Pulls in 'LRCLIB lyrics fallback'.
name: Lyrics options on play long-press

description: Replaces the static neon brand accents with wallpaper-based Monet dynamic colors (M3 Expressive primary/secondary/tertiary roles) on Android 12+. Older versions keep stock colors.
name: Monet dynamic colors

description: Night-only player theme: removes the cover-art tint and paints the now-playing row, pills and action icons with the primary accent at night; day mode keeps the stock tinted player. Pulls in 'Player theme background' resources.
name: Player theme

description: Makes the player background, text, icons and seekbar follow the app's day/night theme. Keeps the darker split below the progress bar. Pair with 'Player theme'.
name: Player theme background

description: No-ops the in-house popup funnel, the fullscreen startup dialog, and the flyer ad callback. Google SDK ads untouched.
name: Remove popup promos

description: Forces SignatureUtils.getAppSignature to hash with the stock cert prefix (he9B...kw=), so X-ANGH-APP-RGSIG matches a stock install. Salt/body hashing unchanged.
name: Spoof stock app signature

description: Forces server shuffleOn=false at both sync points, never reports shuffle to the server, disables the pick-a-song radio redirect, enables shuffle buttons, and disarms the shuffle upsell dialog. Manual shuffle toggle and the header Shuffle button keep working.
name: Unforce shuffle

description: No-ops download limit asserts, forces limited-plan=false and large offline caps (999999). Local gates only; the server still authorizes files.
name: Unlock downloads

description: Forces Account.isPlus/isPlusUser=true, enablePlayerRestrictions=false, canPlayOfflineAndFree=true. Local UI/gating only; server premium checks remain.
name: Unlock local Plus

description: Disables skip and queue limits (skipLimitReached/queueRestrictionsEnabled=false, disable-flags=true). Local gates only.
name: Unlock playback limits

description: Imports device subtitle files into Nuvio's ExoPlayer subtitle menu without rebuilding active playback.
name: Allow Importing Subs from Local Storage

description: Downloads selected direct movie and episode sources to local storage for exact local playback.
name: Local Downloads

description: Adds Library > Storage playback, folder selection, and same-basename sidecar subtitles for local video files.
name: Local Media

description: Marks explicitly labelled SDH tracks and detected English SDH subtitle files.
name: Mark SDH Subtitles

description: Adds persistent per-show random playback with All or Unwatched episode pools.
name: Random Episode

description: Adds Settings → Morphe → Subtitles to normalize music symbols and remove SDH annotations from Media3 subtitles.
name: Remove SDH Annotations

description: Installs the patched app separately as Nuvio Morphe instead of replacing NuvioTV.
name: Side-by-side installation

description: Replaces the launcher icon, the start animation and the SoundCloud logo icons with the Arsound icon.
name: Arsound branding

description: Uses a separate Android account type, so the app can sign in while the original SoundCloud app is installed. Required with "Change package name".
name: Change account type

description: Appends ".revanced" to the package name by default. Changing the package name of the app can lead to unexpected issues.
name: Change package name

name: Control playback advertisements

description: Changes the app name shown on the home screen and in the "Open with" dialog.
name: Custom app name

description: Adds an option to disable SoundCloud's telemetry system.
name: Disable telemetry

description: Adds a "Download file" button to the track menu and a download check to the playlist menu, for tracks whose artist enabled free downloads.
name: Download tracks

description: Adds an option to hide re-uploads of the same song in home sections and autoplay.
name: Hide duplicate recommendations

description: Adds an option to remove the SoundCloud Go and Go+ offer screen and marketing popups.
name: Hide subscription offers

description: Adds importing audio files, playing them in the SoundCloud player and adding any track to any playlist on this device only.
name: Local music

description: Adds network options to the app HTTP clients, including a developer option that simulates a slow connection.
name: Network

description: Shows stored playlists and albums immediately and refreshes them in the background.
name: Offline first playlists

description: Plays tracks downloaded by Arsound from the file instead of streaming them.
name: Play downloaded files

description: Adds an option to reduce background network polling.
name: Power saving

description: Adds a ReVanced menu to the SoundCloud settings, styled like the app.
name: Settings

description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to Threads within ten minutes, or after any time away with No time limit on. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still load new posts.
name: Block background-return feed refresh

description: Redirects matched Pigeon, default event-log and MQTT analytics addresses. Settings show which address kinds were patched. Other telemetry may remain.
name: Disable analytics

description: Videos in feed posts don't play by themselves as you scroll. Tap one to watch it full screen.
name: Disable video autoplay

description: Takes sponsored posts out of your Threads feed before they're shown.
name: Hide ads

description: Removes verified server cards suggesting accounts to follow. Ordinary posts, reposts and unknown card types stay.
name: Hide suggested users

description: Adds HushThreads settings to Threads. Long-press Threads' launcher icon, or open Additional settings in the app on Threads' App info page, to turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.
name: HushThreads settings

description: Opens the web links you tap in your default browser instead of Threads' own, without Threads' click tracker. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads.
name: Open links in browser

description: Threads' dark mode uses pure black instead of its dark gray behind your feed, posts and profiles, which looks deeper and saves power on an OLED screen. Menus and sheets keep their own grays.
name: Pure black dark mode

description: Stops Threads getting your phone's advertising ID from Google Play services. Threads gets a string of zeros in its place.
name: Remove the advertising ID

description: Lets Threads trust itself again on a re-signed build and share sign-in information with an Instagram installed with this build's own key. Both apps keep their current signing keys. A Root Mount install doesn't need this patch.
name: Restore screens on re-signed builds

description: Takes Threads' tracking tags, such as xmt, off the links you share or copy, and turns a short share link into the post's own link. The post a link opens stays the same.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description:
View stories without sending any information to the server. 
Your view will not appear in the story viewers list. 
Note: Since no data is sent, a story you have already viewed may appear as new on another device.
name: Anonymous story viewing

description: Replaces the domain name of shared links.
name: Change link sharing domain

description: Disables analytics that are sent periodically.
name: Disable analytics

description: Removes the auto-scroll toggle and prevents Reels from scrolling automatically.
name: Disable Reels auto-scroll

description: Disables the endless scrolling behavior in Instagram Reels, preventing swiping to the next Reel. Note: On a clean install, the 'Tip' animation may appear but will stop on its own after a few seconds.
name: Disable Reels scrolling

description: Disables the signature check that can cause the app to crash on startup. Using this patch may cause issues with sharing or opening external Instagram links.
name: Disable signature check

description: Disable stories automatically flipping/skipping after some seconds.
name: Disable story auto flipping

description: Disables swiping between the main navigation tabs and swiping to the camera. Tapping the tabs still works.
name: Disable swipe navigation

description: Adds a "Download" option to the post "..." menu to save photos and videos.
name: Download media

description:
Enables the developer menu, which can be found at the bottom of settings menu with name 'Internal Settings'.

It is recommended to use this patch with an alpha/beta Instagram release. Patching a stable release works, but the developer menu shows the developer flags as numbers and does not show a human readable description.
name: Enable developer menu

description: Unlocks the redesigned location sticker with additional style options.
name: Enable location sticker redesign

description: Hides posts and reels from the explore/search page.
name: Hide explore feed

description: Hides the highlights tray in profile section.
name: Hide highlights tray

description: Hides navigation bar buttons, such as the Reels and Create button.
name: Hide navigation buttons

options.description: Permanently hides the Home button. App starts at next available tab.
options.name: Hide Home

description: Hides Stories from the main page, by removing the buttons.
name: Hide Stories from Home

description: Hides suggested stories, reels, threads and survey from feed (Suggested posts will still be shown).
name: Hide suggested content

description: Filters the home feed to display only content from profiles you follow.
name: Limit feed to followed profiles

description: Changes links to always open in your external browser, instead of the in-app browser.
name: Open links externally

description: Removes the registration of screen capture callbacks, preventing Instagram from detecting screenshots or notifying the sender.
name: Prevent screenshot detection

description: Removes the popup that appears after a while, when the app version ages.
name: Remove build expired popup

name: Remove screenshot restriction

description: Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.
name: Sanitize sharing links

name: Allow screenshots

name: AMOLED black theme

options.description: The colour dark mode's backgrounds take, as #RRGGBB. Cards and inputs take a lighter step of it. Leave it blank for black. A colour too light for Facebook's white text is refused.
